translations.web: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
translations.bsb: A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who stays closer than a brother.
translations.kjv: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
translations.asv: He that maketh many friends doeth it to his own destruction; But there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
